description: ONE Polymarket market's trades WITH the wallet behind each, newest first, paged: who traded, which side, how many shares and at what price, from 2026-01-01 to a few minutes ago, read from the on-chain trade tape. Takes the market's `condition_id` (0x plus 64 hex digits, from polymarket_markets or polymarket_market_detail), NOT an outcome token id. Returns {trades, has_more, next_cursor}; while has_more is true pass next_cursor back as `cursor` for the next, older page. `from_ms` is inclusive and `to_ms` exclusive (epoch ms). A page is 100 rows by default and at most 10,000; a row is ~430 characters (a 66-character transaction hash and a 42-character wallet), so ask for what the context window holds. ONE ROW IS ONE ORDER'S FILL, NOT ONE MATCH: a match is several rows (the resting `maker` orders that were hit, plus one `taker` row for the aggressor, whose size is the sum of theirs), so never add size * price over both roles. A few percent of fills are merged away, so a count can sit slightly under the on-chain total. `proxy_wallet` is Polymarket's proxy wallet, not necessarily the person's own address. For the recorded order book (no wallets) use polymarket_tape; for one wallet's whole record use polymarket_wallet.

condition_id.description: The market's condition id: 0x followed by 64 hex digits.

cursor.description: The previous page's next_cursor, passed back unchanged.

from_ms.description: Trade time, epoch MILLISECONDS, inclusive. Omit for the first trade.

limit.description: Rows per page (default 100, max 10000, as the REST route).

to_ms.description: Trade time, epoch milliseconds, EXCLUSIVE; must be greater than from_ms. Omit for no upper bound.

name: polymarket_market_trades
title: Polymarket Market Trades
